name: DataTrust El Salvador / DataTrust Tier III Data Center
developer: Codisa / Grupo Aristos; operated by DataTrust, later aligned with IFX Networks per Baxtel
notes: Official site identifies El Salvador's first Tier III-certified commercial data center at Km 37.5 Pan-American Highway, Altius Tech Park, Ciudad Arce, La Libertad Centro, with colocation/cloud services and 100% renewable energy. DCD reported inauguration on 2024-07-18 and prior 2021 groundbreaking for a 322-rack, 3.5 MW, US$30m project in Ciudad Arce/La Libertad.

name: DATA RED Data Center / Centro de Datos de Intelfon
notes: DATA RED LinkedIn describes DATARED as Intelfon's data center, built and operated under Motorola R56 and TIA-942 standards for server/storage/equipment hosting; headquarters/location listed at Antiguo Cuscatlan, Parque Industrial Santa Elena, La Libertad. Diario El Mundo reported Sigfox IoT infrastructure was deployed by Intelfon's Data Red data center.

name: Bitcoin City geothermal bitcoin-mining infrastructure
developer: Government of El Salvador / LaGeo concept
notes: Included as server-farm-adjacent rather than a conventional colocation data center. Public summaries describe planned Bitcoin City in La Union/Conchagua using geothermal energy to power bitcoin mining; later reporting emphasizes delays/controversy and related infrastructure impacts. No specific MW or constructed mining data-center facility confirmed.

name: Flynet Datacenter Tier 2 - San Miguel
notes: Datacenters.com lists Flynet Datacenter Tier 2 - San Miguel in San Miguel, El Salvador, offering colocation/dedicated-server-related services as part of Flynet's domestic infrastructure. No operator primary page or MW found.

name: Navégalo El Salvador Data Center
notes: Navégalo official location page lists San Salvador, El Salvador, with certified data-center operations, cloud/connectivity/cybersecurity/managed services, colocation, Tier III/Rated-3/PCI DSS/ISO 27001/Carbon Neutral certifications, and regional NOC/SOC support. Third-party listings place the facility at 9 Calle Poniente / 96 Avenida N., San Salvador.

name: IPXON San Salvador Data Center
notes: IPXON official El Salvador page lists a 2024 new data center in San Salvador (SAL) as part of its Latin America edge-computing/datacenter network. Third-party listings identify the site as IPXON San Salvador at Pje Carbonell 26 / Colonia Roma, San Salvador, offering colocation, dedicated servers and VPS.

name: Flynet Datacenter Tier 2 - San Salvador
notes: Datacenters.com lists a Flynet Tier 2 facility in San Salvador, El Salvador, and Flynet's provider page lists three data centers including San Salvador and San Miguel. No operator primary page or MW found.

name: State Data Center / Centro de Datos del Estado
developer: Government of El Salvador, Secretaría de Innovación de la Presidencia; financed by IDB loan program
notes: IDB approved US$60m Program for Development of El Salvador's Data Infrastructure, including adapting/equipping a building to operate a State Data Center and state cloud for about 57 government institutions. El Mundo reported US$9m budget incorporation for design/adaptation of an existing state building of about 3,500 sqm and a total US$30m component for the data infrastructure; sources do not disclose the exact building/site, so San Salvador division assignment reflects central-government implementation and capital-region context rather than a confirmed street address.

name: Universidad en Línea / UES data center
developer: Ministerio de Educación (MINED) and Universidad de El Salvador (UES)
notes: DCD reported on 2016-01-21 that MINED and UES launched Universidad en Línea/Educación a Distancia supported by a modern data center supplied to UES, with connectivity improvements at campuses in San Salvador, Santa Ana, San Vicente and San Miguel; investment reported at US$1.7m. Assigned to San Salvador because UES central campus is in San Salvador and no separate facility address was provided.
